appDescription: A personalized navigation assistant that starts vehicle route guidance to places the user frequently visits.

function.name: NAVIGATE_TO_PLACE
function.description: Start route guidance to one of the user's personal places that this app has learned from the user's visit history. Use this when the user asks to go to a personal place referred to by its type or role rather than a searchable business name, such as '유치원 안내해줘', '유치원 가자', '학원으로 가자', '헬스장 안내해줘'.

placeName.description: The place type or name exactly as the user said it.

confirmed.description: Set to true only when the user has agreed after being asked to confirm the destination; omit it on the first request.

selectedPlace.description: Name of the place the user chose after being asked to pick one of several candidate places; omit it on the first request.
